newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nov manufacturing up 6.3 pct yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nov manufacturing up 6.3 pct yr-on-yr.

text.p: A survey of 58 manufacturing industries in Malaysia showed sales in November 1996 rose 6.3 percent to 15.2 billion ringgit over November 1995, the Statistics Department said on Tuesday.
The November 1996 output was 2.6 percent lower than in October 1996, the department was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency.
It said the 58 industries reported a total sales value of 163.6 billion ringgit for the first 11 months of 1996, up 13.6 percent over the year earlier period.
A total of 31 industries contributed 91.1 percent of total sales value.
They included semi-conductors, electronic components and communication equipment, radio and television sets, audio equipment, crude oil refineries, motor vehicles and office equipment and computers.
